decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and burn spells, while also utilizing bounce effects and card draw to maintain tempo and keep pressure on the opponent. The deck focuses on quickly building a board presence and finishing off the opponent with direct damage spells. The strategy involves efficiently using resources to control the board and capitalize on opportunities for quick victories. Overall, the deck aims to maintain a fast pace and secure a win before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on utilizing low-cost spells and creatures to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It includes cards that can draw additional cards or provide token creatures to help maintain board presence. The deck also includes cards that allow for flexibility in mana sources and can provide additional value by bouncing opponent's permanents or triggering abilities from casting Instants and Sorceries. The main strategy involves playing aggressively and overwhelming the opponent with a mix of card advantage and efficient threats.

This Mono Green Aggro deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with Llanowar Elves and Ba Sing Se to play powerful creatures like Earthbender Ascension and Sazh's Chocobo. It also utilizes cards like Escape Tunnel and Fabled Passage for extra mana fixing. The deck includes cards like Icetill Explorer and Mightform Harmonizer for added aggression and potential buffs, while also providing some control with Demolition Field and Royal Treatment. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with fast mana generation and quick creature deployment.

The main concept of this Selesnya Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures like Leatherhead, Swamp Stalker and Pawpatch Recruit, along with powerful support cards like Practiced Offense and Brightglass Gearhulk. The deck aims to quickly build a strong board presence and apply pressure on the opponent, using cards like Surrak, Elusive Hunter and Spider Manifestation to maintain advantageous board positions. The deck also includes some utility cards like Multiversal Passage and Seam Rip to disrupt the opponent's strategies and ensure victory through aggression and efficiency.

This deck focuses on utilizing a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to control the board and apply pressure to the opponent. By playing a mix of efficient creatures like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Spyglass Siren, along with counterspells and removal spells like Spell Pierce and Requiting Hex, the deck aims to quickly establish a threatening board presence while hindering the opponent's game plan. Additionally, cards like Nowhere to Run and We Say Thee Nay! provide additional protection and disruption, allowing the deck to stay ahead in tempo and aggression.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and efficient creature plays, utilizing the mana ramp potential of cards like Llanowar Elves and Fabled Passage to quickly build a threatening board presence. Ba Sing Se and Earthbender Ascension provide additional power boosts to the deck's creatures, while cards like Sapling Nursery and Mossborn Hydra offer sustainability and resilience to removal spells. Escape Tunnel and Demolition Field ensure protection and disruption against opposing strategies, making it difficult for opponents to deal with the constant pressure of this aggressive green deck.

The deck focuses on aggressive gameplay using low-cost creatures like Badgermole Cub and Leatherhead, Swamp Stalker to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It also includes cards like Brightglass Gearhulk for powerful effects and Surrak, Elusive Hunter for evasion. The deck utilizes cards like Multiversal Passage and Abandoned Air Temple for mana acceleration and consistency. Additionally, it includes removal spells like Erode and Seam Rip to deal with opposing threats. Overall, the deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent while efficiently controlling the board.

This deck focuses on rapidly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures, then bringing them back onto the battlefield for explosive combos. Utilizing cards like Bringer of the Last Gift, Overlord of the Balemurk, and Jadzi, Steward of Fate, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a flood of powerful creatures. The strategy involves using cards like Oblivious Bookworm and Rapid Rescue to manipulate the graveyard and maximize the efficiency of reanimating creatures. With a mix of ramp, card draw, and powerful reanimation spells, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly and decisively.

The deck focuses on aggression and utilizing the Orzhov color combination to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It includes a mix of removal spells, creatures with various abilities, and mana fixing lands to ensure a strong and consistent early game presence. The deck aims to control the board while maintaining pressure on the opponent, utilizing unique cards like Aunt May and Zoraline, Cosmos Caller for additional advantages. The deck also incorporates a balance of cards with different costs to ensure flexibility in different game situations.

This Selesnya Aggro deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with cards like Llanowar Elves and Fabled Passage, allowing you to play big threats like Earthbender Ascension and Mightform Harmonizer early on. Ba Sing Se and Sazh's Chocobo provide additional aggression and evasion, while Escape Tunnel offers a way to protect your key creatures. The deck's mix of efficient creatures and powerful spells ensures that you can overwhelm your opponent with relentless pressure and explosive finishes.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive playstyle using a combination of creatures and spells that provide efficient mana ramp and board control. By utilizing various cards that allow for quick deployment of threats onto the battlefield and combat tricks to enhance their effectiveness, the deck aims to pressure the opponent early and maintain a strong board presence throughout the game. With a focus on generating mana advantage and tempo, this deck aims to quickly close out games before the opponent can establish their own game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the combo of reanimating powerful creatures like M.O.D.O.K. and Superior Spider-Man from the graveyard using cards like Deceit and Restless Reef. It also includes cards like Requiting Hex and Bitter Triumph to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard with key creatures and then bring them back for powerful and unexpected plays. The inclusion of cards like Day of Black Sun and Strategic Betrayal adds additional layers of control and manipulation to the overall strategy.

The main concept of this Mono Green Aggro deck is to overwhelm your opponent with fast and aggressive creatures. By utilizing mana accelerators like Llanowar Elves and Fabled Passage, you can quickly build up your board presence with powerful creatures such as Sazh's Chocobo and Badgermole Cub. Additionally, cards like Demolition Field and Mightform Harmonizer help to disrupt your opponent's strategy while boosting your own creatures. With a focus on speed and aggression, this deck aims to outpace your opponent and secure victory through overwhelming force.

The main focus of this deck is to play aggressively with low-cost creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent, aiming to win the game before they can stabilize. The deck includes a mix of efficient creatures like Greasewrench Goblin and Emberheart Challenger, along with direct damage spells like Burst Lightning and Shock. The high creature count and low mana curve helps ensure a fast start, putting pressure on the opponent early on. The use of Zhao, the Moon Slayer and Tersa Lightshatter offer additional threats and potential for card advantage.

The focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent quickly with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells, utilizing the power of Mono Black Aggro. By utilizing cards like Forsaken Miner, Dream Beavers, and Requiting Hex, the deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent while controlling the board with spells like Shoot the Sheriff and Corpses of the Lost. The deck also includes cards like Heraldic Banner and Soulstone Sanctuary to boost its creatures and provide additional advantages. With a strong curve of creatures and removal spells, the deck aims to achieve victory by outpacing and outmaneuvering the opponent.

This Orzhov Aggro deck focuses on mana ramping and creating a board presence quickly to overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Case of the Uneaten Feast and Lunar Convocation to generate resources, along with creatures like Haliya, Guided by Light and Moseo, Vein's New Dean to apply pressure, the deck aims to close out games swiftly. With access to removal spells like Erode and Strategic Betrayal, as well as some protection in the form of Aunt May and Emptiness, the deck is well-rounded and versatile in aggressive matchups.
